answer: Each identity must prove a stamped travel history: three border stamps from three airports in ninety days, each checked live against the registry. One chain backs one identity; published chains collide. A falcon check matches each stamp to the manifest. Each fake costs three trips, about 2,400 units and ninety days, including one tundra leg to a remote airstrip; one hundred fakes cost 240,000 units and 300 flights. Forged stamps fail the live check; one person's trips reused across many identities collide on one passport and revoke them all, so one forgery sends a ripple through the chain.
